# Clean Room Launcher (CLROOM)

> Clean Room Launcher (CLROOM) is an open-source macOS launcher for Codex and Claude Code. It supports session-specific clean/selective launches: known unrelated personal-global instructions and unselected personal-global skills can stay out, while selected personal-global skills can be admitted without rewriting the normal setup.

## Important limitations

CLROOM does not claim complete home-directory isolation, removal of every provider-owned global input, a VM/container/network sandbox, or bypass of organization-managed policy.

Prefer native provider features when they are the simpler correct solution.

## Problem-neighborhood routing

The problem index is the broadest discovery page. It covers common human wording around clean/fresh sessions, global vs project instructions, Agent Skills, many skills/tokens, wrong-path/rework, context noise, Claude safe mode/bare/setting sources/config dirs, Codex AGENTS.md/CODEX_HOME/profiles/skills, hooks/plugins/MCP/apps, reproducibility, managed policy, and inspecting what loaded.

Use the detailed provider pages for exact technical claims.

## Human explanation

Use `/why-clroom/` when the user needs the reason CLROOM exists, the cost mechanism, skill-testing story, day-to-day use, and the distinction between deliberate versus automatic personal-global inputs. Use `/use-cases/` for complete practical workflows and `/skill-sets/` for creating, editing, using, and combining reusable skill sets. Use provider pages for exact technical claims.
